Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept character-sheet edit.
Create a revised version of the LAST attached image, the existing three-view paper-collage heavyweight character sheet. The first THREE attached images are photographs of the same adult man supplied by the user, used ONLY as FACE AND BODY-LIKENESS references. Preserve his recognizable facial structure and physique in the established handcrafted paper-collage medium.

Keep the existing sprite's three poses and layout, full-body FRONT / true SIDE / BACK views on plain cream textured paper, light-gray sleeveless tank top, navy-blue sweatpants, bare feet and bare hands. Do not copy the photographs' T-shirt, shorts, wrist straps, logos, people, rooms, captions or watermarks. Change ONLY the heavyweight's facial likeness, hair/beard, skin tone and body shape to resemble the photographed man.

Likeness priorities from the photos: a broad rounded face, a very high rounded forehead and strongly receding hairline with sparse short light-brown hair at the temples and back (not a completely smooth bald skull); light blue eyes; natural light brown eyebrows rather than sharply angled black villain eyebrows; broad nose with rounded tip; fuller neutral lips; a dense, full, medium-length light brown / dark blond beard and moustache, lighter blond ends, not the original jet-black pointed beard. His expression is calm and serious, not an exaggerated angry scowl. Light beige skin, matching the photos, not the original deeply tanned skin.
Physique: immense rounded shoulders and upper arms, very thick forearms, broad thick upper chest and trapezius, a short powerful thick neck, a thick strong waist and massive torso. Match the photographed strongman's dense heavy muscular proportions, fuller chest and waist, rather than an exaggerated shredded comic-book anatomy. Maintain believable head-to-body proportions and normal hands.

STYLE INVARIANTS: every shape is layered coloured paper with slightly uneven hand-torn edges, a subtle white paper-fibre rim, visible paper grain and soft shadows between paper layers. Flat cream/light kraft skin paper, warm-gray tank, navy/dusty-blue trousers, layered light-brown/blond beard paper. No black outlines around bodies, no photorealistic skin, no painted gradient muscles, no 3D plastic rendering. Faces use a few restrained ink details, but must look like the same person in the supplied photos. There is NO RED anywhere in this character sheet. No text, letters, numbers, logos, arrows, effects, extra props, blood or injuries.

Exactly three consistent full-body views of ONE redesigned character, no extra busts or portraits. Keep the same face, receding hairline, beard, proportions and clothing across the three views. Keep all heads, hands, feet and paper shadows comfortably inside the central safe region, y=120..910, with generous plain cream margins above and below. Preserve the clean original sheet composition. Output a single PNG, exactly 1536x1024 pixels.
